code:
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols: { grpc: {}, http: {} }

processors:
  batch: {}
  memory_limiter: { check_interval: 1s, limit_mib: 400 }

exporters:
  otlp/jaeger:
    endpoint: {{jaeger_endpoint}}
    tls: { insecure: true }
  prometheusremotewrite:
    endpoint: {{prom_endpoint}}

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
      exporters: [otlp/jaeger]
    metrics:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [memory_limiter, batch]
      exporters: [prometheusremotewrite]
summary_zh: OTel Collector,trace 出 Jaeger,metrics 推 Prom RW
